content: Pole na Barenabase o Yikonyome
O Yikonyome wandi Pole na Barenabase bakekote o ndaghu dusambu dji baSwife. Bamasamune musamu Nzambi, lake baSwife na baNgereke bapwele bamasinge musamu Djesu.
Tumbe baSwife abasamasinge Nzambi, bakerombise matase mabive ombu djowu abasamabe baSwife, na bakebasibise bwé bakéwululu bango yitu.

Tumbe dikalewube nane, Pole na Barenabase bamatsinge o musyengi Yikonyome. Bamasamunaange musamu Nzambi na musighe. Fumu amabaveghaange mangolu movaghe bimaghe na bilimbe bineni na makake mowu, mu ulase yiri, musamu awu bamalonzaange mu yese yandi, wungenze.
O musyengi Yikonyome, vakebe dupasu va ghari yinombu yi batu ba musyengi. Bamosi bakebe o yari yi baSwife, mba bane o yari yi bilumbi.
Tumbe baSwife na bo basamabe baSwife na bivunde byowu bakekunzeme mukwane notinde mamani mu uboke bilumbi.
Djowu badidjabilaange, bakeyesweme o misyengi mi Likoni, Lisetere na Derebe, na mu mighule myowu.
Aghune, bakesamune Musamu Wuboti.
Dubelusu du yikoyi o Lisetere
O musyengi Lisetere wumabe yikoyi, yimaburu mambolutu, asamarungulaange uwende diteli. Matsane,
amawulu nane Pole amavosilaange. Pole anomughengile, akelabe yiri ane yitu yiwelimine yughobululu.
Pole akemutsingule rye: «Releme, sumbiti mu makulu maghu!» Yikoyi yeni akesundile ureleme na akevaghe mwa batake.
Mughungi wunolabe adi Pole amavaghe, wukevose o mbembu dji bise Likoni yi: «Banyambi bamabonge manyuru ma batu na bamavindeme ombu etu!».
Bamanengile Barenabase «Sese», mumbari Sese amabe yivunde yi banzambi bowu. Pole bakemunengile «Yirmese», mumba amabe djandi omavosaange pwele.

Ndaghu dji nyambi Sese djimabe beli na dikotulu di musyengi. Anowulu mambu meni, muvaghulitsi paghu wu nyambi eni akebeghe bangombi abebamadwise na kembu, va wusu mughungi eni. Bamarondaange yi bangombi beni bakeveghu nane paghu ombu Barenabase djone Pole mu baghobise.
Bilumbi Pole na Barenabase, banodidjabe, bakepase bikutu byowu mu kevongule na bakesobene mu mughungi, noghamughe:

«Bambatsi betu, mubayi dwivayili nane? Tudji batu nane djenu. Twidubeyili Musamu Wuboti, muvaghe yiri dukesanze mutsanu enu. Mbé dusile bakosi abaghane tsongu, nosinge Nzambi-Pungu omasunde djulu, butambe, mubu na byotsu abivu mune.
Mu temu atsimavyoghe, Nzambi amasile malongu motsu wuyenewendaange kulini-kulini.
Ne vane, Nzambi asamadunde udulase maboti mandi. Adine, amadutindilaange mamvule na bivaru mu temu adjiwelimine. Amabwéduveghe bighudji na amabase mirime myenu na nzangu.»
Yike bakale uvose nane, bilumbi bamalabe diweru dyughandise mughungi, bwé akébavaghulile paghu.

Va djulu vane, mwa baSwife bamosi bakerughesene o musyengi Antyose no Yikonyome, bakesibise mughungi mu kwane Pole djone Barenabase. Mba baketinde Pole mamani mu muboke. Na ditase yi Pole amafu, bakemudute mu mupalise o musyengi owu.
Tumbe badukitsi banomukande, akereleme na akekote nowu o musyengi. Va kedi, akewende na Barenabase o musyengi Derebe.
Pole djone Barenabase béghabuyi o musyengi Antyose dji Siri
Pole na Barenabase bamasamune Musamu Wuboti o musyengi Derebe, awu bamadilile badukitsi bapwele. Mba bakeghabughe o Lisetere, o Yikonyome na Antyose.
Bamayenewarisaange badukitsi, nobalonzaange ube na yikanene mu yitu ombu Nzambi. Na bamabwébalubusaange yi: «Tuvyolanu mu maghughe mapwele ne tukekote mu Bukaghe bu Nzambi.»
Mu kale dibundu bamababyatsile bivunde, mba yikebemani uwarile nzale nosambile, bakebawakise va makake ma Fumu adji bamavayile yitu.
Bakevyole o yinange yi Pisidi, na baketole o yinange yi Pafili.
Banomane ulonze mbembu Nzambi o musyengi Perse, bamavindeme o musyengi Atali.
Va djulu vane, bakenangeme mu watange mu wende o musyengi Antyose dji Siri, musyengi awu bamabyatsulu mu yese yi Nzambi dibandu yisalu ayi bamavaghe.
Banotole o Antyose, Pole djone Barenabase bakeghukighe dibundu. Bakebatsingule motsu ame Nzambi amavaghe mu kake mowu, na nane amaghobulile batu bapwele abasamabe baSwife.
Pole djone Barenabase bamavyose temu djineni va ghari badukitsi ba yinange yi Antyose.
